'''Lower Markaran Outpost''', originally '''Markaran Imperial Outpost''', was an outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] located in the [[Markaran Plains]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Thorpe (lieutenant)|Thorpe]], [[Fixer 66]], [[Science officer/Legends|Science Officer]] [[Garboza]], and [[Toybox]] were stationed at the outpost. It was later taken over by the [[Balmorran resistance]], with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeants]] [[Durren (sergeant)|Durren]] and [[Kejik (Balmorra)|Kejik]] stationed there.
